title: Glowing rose
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6688' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#ff3355' stop-opacity='0.12'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff3355' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='petalGrad' cx='45%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8899'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#e8244a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b01030'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='innerGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffaabb'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc2244'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='44' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 58 Q48 72 46 88 Q50 90 54 88 Q52 72 50 58 Z' fill='#2d8a4e'/>
  <path d='M50 58 Q48 72 46 88' fill='none' stroke='#45b868' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- leaf left -->
  <path d='M47 75 Q34 68 30 76 Q36 82 47 79 Z' fill='#3aa85a'/>
  <path d='M47 75 Q38 73 33 76' fill='none' stroke='#5cd47a' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- leaf right -->
  <path d='M52 68 Q64 62 67 70 Q61 75 52 72 Z' fill='#3aa85a'/>
  <path d='M52 68 Q60 67 64 70' fill='none' stroke='#5cd47a' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- outer petals -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='18' ry='13' fill='url(#petalGrad)' transform='rotate(0 50 45)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='18' ry='13' fill='url(#petalGrad)' transform='rotate(72 50 45)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='18' ry='13' fill='url(#petalGrad)' transform='rotate(144 50 45)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='18' ry='13' fill='url(#petalGrad)' transform='rotate(216 50 45)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='18' ry='13' fill='url(#petalGrad)' transform='rotate(288 50 45)'/>

  <!-- middle petals -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f0436a' transform='rotate(36 50 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f0436a' transform='rotate(108 50 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f0436a' transform='rotate(180 50 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f0436a' transform='rotate(252 50 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f0436a' transform='rotate(324 50 42)'/>

  <!-- inner swirl -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='7' ry='6' fill='url(#innerGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#ff8899'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='2' ry='1.8' fill='#ffccdd'/>

  <!-- petal highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='30' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff99aa' opacity='0.5' transform='rotate(-20 44 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='32' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff99aa' opacity='0.4' transform='rotate(25 57 32)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='28' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#ffbbcc' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
